engine.description: Shared HTML5 game engine modules: GameLoop, CollisionUtils, EnemyController, RenderLayers, ProceduralAudio, etc.

agents.description: AI Game Factory agent role definitions with inputs, outputs, and acceptance criteria.

game-designer.description: Transforms game concepts into game-design-intent.md, game-contract.json, and content-requirements.json. Defines kinematics, mechanics, and progression.

level-designer.description: Creates level-graph.json with validated geometry, ASCII paper prototypes, and room purpose contracts.

builder.description: Implements game source code (game.js, index.html, style.css) using engine modules and RenderLayers.

debugger.description: Reads playtest reports, reproduces bugs, identifies root causes, applies fixes, and verifies.

polisher.description: Adds juice: squash/stretch, particles, screen shake, procedural audio, micro-animations.

reviewer.description: Evaluates games against master quality checklist. Issues PASS or FAIL with routing instructions.

game.description: Create a new game through the full AI Game Factory pipeline

build.description: Build a game into production ZIP (usage: /build <game-id>)

test.description: Run validation and test suite for a game (usage: /test <game-id>)
